statement: For EVERY real t, kappa>=0, and twelve arbitrary nonnegative real d_ij (i!=j), every 2-block-positive 4x4 operator W=t sum_i[|ii>]+sum_(i!=j)d_ij[|ij>]-kappa[omega], omega=sum_i|ii>, is decomposable. Consequently this entire diagonal-minus-maximally-correlated-projector family is nonnegative on every 4x4 PPT state. No cyclic, matching, symmetric, or product-metric hypothesis on d_ij is needed. This is a single structured witness family, not a resolution of 4x4 PPT/SN3.
normalization_and_necessary_tests: If kappa=0, 2-block positivity forces t>=0 and W is PSD. If kappa>0, divide W and all coefficients by kappa. A rank-two e_ii+e_jj test forces normalized t>=2; for t>=4 W is PSD. Thus put D=t-1 in [1,3], delta=3-D, q_ij=sqrt(d_ij*d_ji), and g=max(0,1-D+2/D). For each pair ij, a rank-two test consisting of the rank-one block [[1,u],[1/u,1]] on i,j plus singleton diagonal 2/D on any other index gives q_ij>=g. For every perfect matching {ij,kl}, a rank-two direct sum of the two rank-one blocks [[1,u],[1/u,1]] and [[1,v],[1/v,1]] gives q_ij+q_kl>=2delta. Both infima remain valid when some coefficients vanish, by taking limits in positive u,v.
decomposition_reduction: Set c_ij=min(q_ij,delta), so g<=c_ij<=delta. For q_ij>0 let the block of B on (|ij>,|ji>) be (c_ij/q_ij)*[[d_ij,-q_ij],[-q_ij,d_ji]]; if q_ij=0 then c_ij=0 and the block is zero. Every B block is PSD. With A=W-B^Gamma, all off-diagonal-basis diagonal entries of A are d_ij*(1-c_ij/q_ij)>=0 (or d_ij if q_ij=0). The only remaining block is M(c) on |00>,|11>,|22>,|33>, with diagonal D and offdiagonal c_ij-1. By the matching inequalities, the graph of pairs with c_ij<delta contains no two disjoint edges. Any such graph on four vertices is a subgraph of a star or a triangle. Since c_ij ranges over [g,delta] and M is affine in c, it suffices by convexity of the PSD cone to check five graph-corner types: empty, one edge, two adjacent edges, the three-edge star, and the triangle; each marked edge has c=g and each other edge c=delta.
corner_psd_proof: Write r=delta-1=2-D and s=g-1. For the empty graph the eigenvalues are D-r=2D-2 (multiplicity three) and D+3r=2(3-D). For one marked edge the two antisymmetric eigenvalues are D-s,D-r and the remaining 2x2 block has diagonal D+s,D+r and determinant F1=(D+s)(D+r)-4r^2. The three-edge star has eigenvalue D-r twice and a 2x2 block with diagonal D,D+2r and determinant Fstar=D(D+2r)-3s^2. The triangle has eigenvalue D-s twice and a 2x2 block with diagonal D,D+2s and determinant Ftri=D(D+2s)-3r^2. For marked edges 01,02 and unmarked 12, the two-edge corner has eigenvalue D-r; its remaining 3x3 block in the basis (e_0,(e_1+e_2)/sqrt(2),e_3) is [[D,sqrt(2)s,r],[sqrt(2)s,D+r,sqrt(2)r],[r,sqrt(2)r,D]]. Its 2x2 principal minors are J2=D(D+r)-2s^2, D^2-r^2, and (D-r)(D+2r), and its determinant is F2=D^2(D+r)-2D*s^2+(4s-3D-r)r^2. The next table proves J2,F2>=0. For 1<=D<=3 all displayed diagonal entries and factors D-r,D-s,D+2s,D+2r,D+3r are nonnegative.

1<=D<=2; s=2/D-D.signs: All factors are nonnegative on [1,2]; the four nontrivial bracketed polynomials have minima at least 1, 1, 4, and 1 respectively.

conclusion: All five corner matrices are PSD, and hence so is M(c) for the actual coefficients. Therefore A>=0 and B>=0 give W=A+B^Gamma after rescaling by kappa. 2-block-positive members cannot detect a PPT state. The explicit rational example in frontier-20261028-matching-symmetric-witness-nogo-v1.json SHA256 374dab4d2e706a2bc5b037958b4c4b60763d58d303f9fe62e9694a26f2a7b765 is 2-block positive but neither PSD nor coPSD, so the mixed decomposition is genuinely needed.

exact_check.observed: The first checker verifies the six F1/Ftri/Fstar factorizations and exact rational PSD for the five actual graph corners at 13 D values, 65 checks. Its additional identities labeled two-edge accidentally use the triangle-type block and are NOT used here. The second checker verifies by integer-coefficient polynomial identities both actual F2/J2 factorizations and the remaining minor identity, and checks their signs at nine rational D values. Commands are PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /usr/bin/env python3 followed by each checker filename. Universal factor signs, rank-two forcing, graph classification and convexity are written proofs, not consequences of finite samples.

relationship_and_limits: This all-variable result supersedes the matching-symmetric and low-t subfamily restrictions in the two earlier packets; those remain independently pinned. The common diagonal coefficient t and a single maximally correlated negative projector are essential hypotheses; unequal diagonal coefficients or general witnesses are not classified. WRITTEN with exact polynomial/rational checks, no independent or formal review and no novelty clearance.
